en: Color photograph of a hilltop Gothic cathedral complex with two tall, dark spires rising above a long, slate-roofed building that looks like a castle or palace. The structure stands on a wooded hillside, with dense green trees in the foreground and a few small houses with steep, tiled roofs at the bottom. The sky is clear and blue with light clouds. No visible text appears on the image side.
